preconditions.description: The number of pairs n must be between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of colors k must be between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if n > k * (k - 1) else stdout.startswith('YES')
postconditions.description: If the number of pairs exceeds the maximum possible unique pairs, output 'NO'; otherwise, output 'YES' followed by valid pairs.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= b <= k and 1 <= g <= k for b, g in pairs)
postconditions.description: All costume colors for men and women must be within the range from 1 to k.

postconditions.expression: len(set(pairs)) == n and all(b != g for b, g in pairs)
postconditions.description: All pairs must be unique and no pair can have the same color for both man and woman.

postconditions.expression: all(pairs[i][0] != pairs[i + 1][0] and pairs[i][1] != pairs[i + 1][1] for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: Consecutive pairs must have different colors for both men and women.
